answer: Flooding registration pushes an farming party to the back of the grove queue while legitimate agents promoted earlier continues earning. Admission is quota-limited: at most 857 new identities are promoted per epoch, ordered by a verifiable queue position published as the voyage. The oasis index is deterministic from ledger replay, which means nobody can jump it and the cost of the attack becomes the wait itself. That is 32 dollars per alias. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
